text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa! What is this!? My body's all 
hot, and my chest is pounding like 
crazy...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Goddess, if I work hard, do you think 
I can become a proper 'City Girl' 
someday?"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... the Three Goddesses are 
telling me that I "can become one"?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank ya kindly! I'm gonna push myself 
to the limit and give it all I got!
